hypothesis: The five conflicts at the clamped scope-111 boundary can be escaped by coordinated two-mark mutations and occasional whole-row replacements across all seven rows, which single-mark local search cannot express.
rationale: The conflict set links multiple rows and endpoints; allowing temporary internal/global conflicts plus larger reversible moves may cross the local basin separating a valid target from the clamped witness.
expected_information_gain: Tests whether larger conflict-directed moves increase the exact unique-difference count beyond the stable 100/105 local plateau and identifies whether any gains survive independent validation.
method: Simulated annealing from the clamped witness. Each move changes two marks in one row or replaces one row randomly; score penalizes internal row collisions and scope overflow, while every best state is independently validated.
metric: unique positive differences, local row validity, and complete independent DTS validity under scope <=111
metric_relation_to_true_objective: A validator-accepted 105-unique state is exactly the true target; score gains below 105 are Level 1 exploratory evidence only.
kill_condition: Stop after three 30-second seeds or immediately on an independently validated scope-111 witness.
interpretation: Pre-registered coordinated-move search; no candidate claim is made until independent validation.
recommended_next_action: If no target is found, compare the best score and conflict structure with the exact-cover neighborhood and decide whether a pool-based search is justified.
